description: Hosted watch (paid only; this MCP call validates and returns how to pay): ToolFit re-audits a public remote MCP server every 24 h ($0.25) or 6 h ($0.60) for 30 days and POSTs an HMAC-SHA256 signed JSON webhook to your https endpoint when its tools/list fingerprint or grade changes, or it goes unreachable or recovers. Pay at POST /v1/watch or /v1/watch/6h with x402 or a credits key; the response has watch_id and the signing secret (shown once).

every.description: Check interval: 24h (default, $0.25 per 30 days) or 6h ($0.60 per 30 days).

url.description: Public remote MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP, https), e.g. https://api.youraitools.co/mcp/hub. ToolFit only lists its tools.

webhook.description: Your https endpoint (public host, port 443) that receives the signed JSON change notifications. A query string is allowed.

name: watch_mcp_server
title: Watch a remote MCP server for changes (ToolFit)
